description: Start on freshly launched Home. Search regression sweep. No account mutation buttons.

steps.name: 01-home
steps.review: Home posters, navigation and normal FPS-hidden appearance

steps.name: 02-search-letters
steps.review: Keyboard opens immediately; compact A-Z/1-0 grid; no filters for an empty query.

steps.name: 03-t9-space
steps.review: Numeric input switches T9; ABC bottom left, zero centered

steps.name: 04-t9-dash
steps.review: 1 clears space; two quick zero presses produce one dash

steps.name: 05-t9-backspace
steps.review: Query is empty; delete removes dash

steps.name: 08-empty-discover
steps.review: Keyboard closes on entry into live discovery rails. No search filters or automatic similar-title tiers.

steps.name: 09-discover-scroll
steps.review: Dynamic rails remain intact; hovering the last rail must not append similar titles.

steps.name: 10-catalog-details
steps.review: Inspect the catalog card if the selected rail has media; directory rails instead require opening a title first.
